mapper.sql: f.id, f.product_id, f.departure_city, f.arrival_city, f.departure_lng, f.departure_lat, f.arrival_lng, f.arrival_lat, f.flight_number, f.duration, f.frequency, f.route_coordinates, f.created_date, f.last_modified_date
, p.name AS product_name, p.description AS product_description, p.price AS product_price, p.stock AS product_stock, p.image_url AS product_image_url, p.status AS product_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flights f INNER JOIN products p ON f.product_id = p.id ORDER BY f.id
SELECT FROM flights f INNER JOIN products p ON f.product_id = p.id WHERE f.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM flights f INNER JOIN products p ON f.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY f.frequency DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flights (product_id, departure_city, arrival_city, departure_lng, departure_lat, arrival_lng, arrival_lat, flight_number, duration, frequency, route_coordinates) VALUES (#{productId}, #{departureCity}, #{arrivalCity}, #{departureLng}, #{departureLat}, #{arrivalLng}, #{arrivalLat}, #{flightNumber}, #{duration}, #{frequency}, #{routeCoordinates})
mapper.update: UPDATE flights SET departure_city = #{departureCity}, arrival_city = #{arrivalCity}, departure_lng = #{departureLng}, departure_lat = #{departureLat}, arrival_lng = #{arrivalLng}, arrival_lat = #{arrivalLat}, flight_number = #{flightNumber}, duration = #{duration}, frequency = #{frequency}, route_coordinates = #{routeCoordinates} WHERE id = #{id}
